subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose a public SKILL.md configuration action, and what URL trust policy should the dashboard enforce for skill-authored configuration links?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but choosing arbitrary frontmatter URLs versus a typed action model changes a public skill contract and dashboard security boundary.

options.title: Add typed config action with URL policy
options.body: Define one public metadata/action shape, reuse or extend `resolveSafeExternalUrl()`, document the trust behavior, and test parser/status/UI handling before implementation.

options.title: Reuse existing homepage/Skill Card paths
options.body: Decline new frontmatter fields for now and direct skill authors to existing homepage or Skill Card surfaces until a broader settings model exists.

options.title: Move this through ClawHub/plugin settings first
options.body: Let ClawHub or plugin metadata own configuration actions, then add core support only if a missing API prevents safe external implementation.

recommendation.title: Add typed config action with URL policy
recommendation.body: Define one public metadata/action shape, reuse or extend `resolveSafeExternalUrl()`, document the trust behavior, and test parser/status/UI handling before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current skill metadata/status surface and recent path history make this the best routing candidate for deciding the core contract shape.
